# Heading numbering reference

Covers hierarchy, starts, continuation, restarts, disabled numbering, custom
sequence IDs, all five formats and an XML-sensitive separator. The default
sequence is shared by numbered headings. A later start is ignored during
continuation; restart replaces the instance. Heading restart at one creates a
new instance without a start override. List and heading definitions are separate.

Label and prefix remain metadata, and the capture reported them as unsupported.
Numbers are Word numbering definitions rather than inserted run text. The model
and every package part are compared. Word rendering remains unreviewed.
